project.name: jobwatch
project.description: Self-hosted, single-owner career-operations backend: collect job postings, evaluate them against approved evidence and confirmed preferences, prepare application materials, and require exact human approval before any Submit.

nodes.name: Canonical Evidence
nodes.summary: Approved source material supporting personal claims, with exact citations; model memory is never a substitute.

nodes.name: Eligibility Gate
nodes.summary: Deterministic admission that decides eligibility from confirmed policy, separate from any holistic fit score.

nodes.name: Exact Input Approval
nodes.summary: Human approval bound to the exact current reviewed inputs; changed inputs invalidate it.

nodes.name: Confirmed Submit
nodes.summary: The final application action, allowed only through submit_confirm.py against an unchanged, reviewed fill.

nodes.name: Ready Package
nodes.summary: A current package that has met the authoritative eligibility, factual and document gates.

nodes.name: Execution Mode
nodes.summary: One effective AI mode (off, reader, pipeline, agentic, screened) chosen per install.

nodes.name: Prescreen
nodes.summary: Reversible admit/flag/skip decision applied to saved postings before paid reading.

nodes.name: Profile Version
nodes.summary: An immutable record of one confirmed or adopted profile, with evidence snapshots.

nodes.name: Search Scope
nodes.summary: The confirmed basis, locations, daily assessments and token ceiling within which discovery and assessment may run.

nodes.name: Decision Policy
nodes.summary: Search strategy, exclusion rules and eligibility constraints derived from the approved profile, separate from target policy.

nodes.name: Field Hypothesis
nodes.summary: A related occupation found by semantic retrieval from approved facts, used to aim discovery and never as proof of qualification.

nodes.name: Evidence Coverage
nodes.summary: The importance-weighted fraction of applicable requirements supported by evidence, with an upper bound for unknowns.

nodes.name: Shortlist Label
nodes.summary: A versioned presentation category (stronger match, stretch, needs clarification); not eligibility or hiring probability.

nodes.name: Preference Model
nodes.summary: A validated local conditional-logit model of human choices among displayed eligible jobs, never hiring probability.

nodes.name: Callback Estimate
nodes.summary: A historical Beta-Binomial callback rate with uncertainty, distinct from a forecast for one job.

nodes.name: Frozen Baseline
nodes.summary: An immutable per-person snapshot of stored pipeline inputs and outputs with gate routes recomputed under a pinned profile.

nodes.name: Budget Accounting
nodes.summary: Reserve, dispatch, settle accounting for model calls that keeps unknown charges conservative and attributable.

nodes.name: Identity Binding
nodes.summary: The server-authenticated owner identity carried through every route, tool, checkpoint and artifact.

nodes.name: Trust Boundary
nodes.summary: The boundary where model text, uploaded files and page content can never confer human authority.

nodes.name: Advisory Memory

tour.title: Start with the product contract
tour.description: Read INTENT.md and GLOSSARY.md first. INTENT.md is normative: it defines the single-owner scope, the Screening -> Evaluation priority, the safety rules and what counts as completion evidence.

tour.title: Follow one collection run
tour.description: jobwatch/run.py is the collection spine: pick a tier, run each collector, dedupe, apply rules, publish to the board, prune, then hand off to the AI step.

tour.title: Understand the execution-mode switch
tour.description: Only one AI mode is effective per install. config/jobwatch.yaml currently sets execution_mode: screened; the switch lives in execution_mode.py and dispatches to screened, graph, reader or the agentic service.

tour.title: Build the candidate model
tour.description: Intake turns uploads into proposals; only a human confirmation creates an immutable profile version. Evidence, eligibility and decision policy are then compiled from that approved version.

tour.title: Trace one paid evaluation
tour.description: The screened mode promotes the best shortlisted jobs into service.run_agentic_job. That path reserves budget, captures the ad, runs the evaluation agent and applies the deterministic gate.

tour.title: Turn results into an explained shortlist
tour.description: Ranking is presentation of evidence coverage, not eligibility. Selection is a separate human approval that only authorizes preparation.

tour.title: Walk documents to the Submit boundary
tour.description: Drafting is followed by deterministic verification, a fresh-context review and packaging. Form preparation stops for exact human review; submit_confirm.py is the only path that presses Submit.

tour.title: Read the state and accounting layer
tour.description: Every paid action is claimed, budgeted and recorded. Incidents are durable, artifacts are hash-checked, and recovery is read-only by design.

tour.title: Meet the client surfaces
tour.description: The native HTTP API is the primary interface; the web board, MCP server, LibreChat adapter, ACP adapter and TUI are clients over the same canonical operations.

tour.title: Verify before believing anything
tour.description: Frozen baselines and replays are development tools, not acceptance. Tests prove mechanics; a merge or a green suite does not prove the deployed backend works.
